slides.title: An empty surface at one end. A published app at the other.
lines: paper.design raised $34M to make the design and the finished product the same thing.
We built ours with no funding at all, and it gives you the result. This is one afternoon on it.

slides.title: It starts with nothing on it.
I asked for my AI spend per day and a chart of the same numbers.
It saw two jobs in that one sentence, said so, and did both.
The table and the chart come from my own usage, not a sample.
An image, a few lines, a number from the surface, and a reply form.
It became an app at its own address, ready to send to anyone.
Replies arrive in CADENCE, our own CRM, tagged with the event.
And the panel beside the invitation lists who is coming.
Data, invitation, published app and the CRM, side by side on one surface.
Under fifteen minutes, one fold at a time.
lines: ORIGAMI is itself an AIMEAT app running on AIMEAT, through the same interfaces everyone else gets. Two bugs it hit today were fixed in the platform for everybody.
Come and see it live on Friday 14 August. Leave your details in the invitation.
